en.title: Constitution Art. 94 — Supreme Court structure
en.short_description: Official extract Constitution Art. 94. Practice drill — not a past paper.
en.learning_objective: Read the official wording of Constitution Art. 94 and map it to High Court Permission practice.
en.explanation:
Official English from https://bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd/act-details-367.html?lang=en (retrieved 2026-09-14). Not lawyer-verified.

94. (1) There shall be a Supreme Court for Bangladesh (to be known as the Supreme Court of Bangladesh) comprising the Appellate Division and the High Court Division. (2) The Supreme Court shall consist of the Chief Justice, to be known as the Chief Justice of Bangladesh, and such number of other Judges as the President may deem it necessary to appoint to each division. (3) The Chief Justice, and the Judges appointed to the Appellate Division, shall sit only in that division, and the other Judges shall sit only in the High Court Division. (4) Subject to the provisions of this Constitution the Chief Justice and the other Judges shall be independent in the exercise of their judicial functions. Appointment of Judges
important_rules: Art. 94(1): one Supreme Court comprising Appellate Division and High Court Division.
Judges of each division sit only in that division.

en.short_description: Official extract Constitution Art. 102. Practice drill — not a past paper.
en.learning_objective: Read the official wording of Constitution Art. 102 and map it to High Court Permission practice.
en.explanation:
Official English from https://bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd/act-details-367.html?lang=en (retrieved 2026-09-14). Not lawyer-verified.

102. (1) The High Court Division on the application of any person aggrieved, may give such directions or orders to any person or authority, including any person performing any function in connection with the affairs of the Republic, as may be appropriate for the enforcement of any of the fundamental rights conferred by Part III of this Constitution. (2) The High Court Division may, if satisfied that no other equally efficacious remedy is provided by law  (a) on the application of any person aggrieved, make an order- (i) directing a person performing any functions in connec-tion with the affairs of the Republic or of a local authority, to refrain from doing that which he is not permitted by law to do or to do that which he is required by law to do ; or (ii) declaring that any act done or proceeding taken by a person performing functions in connection with the affairs of the Republic or of a local authority, has been done or taken without lawful authority and is of no legal effect ; or (b) on the application of any person, make an order- (i) directing that a person in custody be brought before it so that it may satisfy itself that he is not being held in custody without lawful authority or in an unlawful manner ; or (ii) requiring a person holding or purporting to hold a public office to show under what authority he claims to hold that office. en.title: Constitution Art. 103 — Appellate Division appeals
en.short_description: Official extract Constitution Art. 103. Practice drill — not a past paper.
en.learning_objective: Read the official wording of Constitution Art. 103 and map it to High Court Permission practice.
en.explanation:
Official English from https://bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd/act-details-367.html?lang=en (retrieved 2026-09-14). AD enrolment is separate from HC Permission.

103. (1) The Appellate Division shall have jurisdiction to hear and determine appeals from judgments, decrees, orders or sentences of the High Court Division. (2) An appeal to the Appellate Division from a judgment, decree, order or sentence of the High Court Division shall lie as of right where the High Court Division  (a) certifies that the case involves a substantial question of law as to the interpretation of this Constitution ; or (b) has confirmed a sentence of death or sentenced a person to death or to imprisonment for life ; or (c) has imposed punishment on a person for contempt of that division ; and in such other cases as may be provided for by Act of Parliament. (3) An appeal to the Appellate Division from a judgment, decree, order or sentence of the High Court Division in a case to which clause (2) does not apply shall lie only if the Appellate Division grants leave to appeal. (4) Parliament may by law declare that the provisions of this article shall apply in relation to any other court or tribunal as they apply in relation to the High Court Division. Issue and execution of processes of Appellate Division 104. The Appellate Division shall have power to issue such directions, orders, decrees or writs as may be necessary for doing complete justice in any cause or matter pending before it, including orders for the purpose of securing the attendance of any person or the discovery or production of any document. Review of judgments or orders by Appellate Division 105. The Appellate Division shall have power, subject to the provisions of any Act of Parliament and of any rules made by that division to review any judgment pronounced or order made by it. Advisory jurisdiction of Supreme Court 106. If at any time it appears to the President that a question of law has arisen, or is likely to arise, which is of such a nature and of such public importance that it is expedient to obtain the opinion of the Supreme Court upon it, he may refer the question to the Appellate Division for consideration and the division may, after such hearing as it thinks fit, report its opinion thereon to the President. Rule-making power of the Supreme Court
important_rules: Art. 103(1): AD hears appeals from HCD judgments, decrees, orders or sentences.
Never merge AD enrolment with the HC Permission drafting paper.

en.title: Constitution Art. 107 — Supreme Court rule-making
en.short_description: Official extract Constitution Art. 107. Practice drill — not a past paper.
en.learning_objective: Read the official wording of Constitution Art. 107 and map it to High Court Permission practice.
en.explanation:
Official English from https://bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd/act-details-367.html?lang=en (retrieved 2026-09-14). Practice directions sit under this power.

107. (1) Subject to any law made by Parliament the Supreme Court may, with the approval of the President, make rules for regulating the practice and procedure of each division of the Supreme Court and of any court subordinate to it. (2) The Supreme Court may delegate any of its functions under clause (1) and article 113 and 116 to a division of that Court or to one or more judges. (3) Subject to any rules made under this article the Chief Justice shall determine which judges are to constitute any Bench of a division of the Supreme Court and which judges are to sit for any purpose. (4) The Chief Justice may authorise the next most senior judge of either division of the Supreme Court to exercise in that division any of the powers conferred by clause (3) or by rules made under this article. Supreme Court as court of record 108. The Supreme Court shall be a court of record and shall have all the powers of such a court including the power subject to law to make an order for the investigation of or punishment for any contempt of itself. Superintendence and control over courts 109. The High Court Division shall have superintendence and control over all courts and tribunals subordinate to it. Transfer of cases from subordinate courts to High Court Division 110. If the High Court Division is satisfied that a case pending in a court subordinate to it involves a substantial question of law as to the interpretation of this Constitution, or on a point of general public importance, the determination of which is necessary for the disposal of the case, it shall withdraw the case from that court and may  (a) either dispose of the case itself ; or (b) determine the question of law and return the case to the court from which it has been so withdrawn (or transfer it to another subordinate court) together with a copy of the judgment of the division on such question, and the court to which the case is so returned or transferred shall, on receipt thereof, proceed to dispose of the case in conformity with such judgment. important_rules: Art. 107(1): Supreme Court may make rules for practice and procedure of each division, with President’s approval, subject to Parliament.

en.question: Under Rule 65A, how many marks is each drafting question worth?
en.explanation: 25 marks per question, across 5 criteria of 5 marks each. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: বিধি ৬৫এ-এর অধীনে, প্রতিটি খসড়া প্রশ্ন কত নম্বরের?
bn.explanation: ৫টি মানদণ্ডে, প্রতিটি ৫ নম্বর করে, প্রশ্নপ্রতি ২৫ নম্বর। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।

en.question: How many marking criteria make up each drafting question's score?
en.explanation: Format, facts, prayer, language & style, law & grounds — 5 marks each. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: প্রতিটি খসড়া প্রশ্নের নম্বর কতটি মানদণ্ড দিয়ে গঠিত?
bn.explanation: ফরম্যাট, ঘটনা, প্রার্থনা, ভাষা ও শৈলী, আইন ও যুক্তি— প্রতিটি ৫ নম্বর। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।

en.question: What are the minimum qualifying marks on the written paper alone?
en.explanation: 12/25 written + 12/25 oral, combined minimum 25. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: শুধুমাত্র লিখিত পত্রে ন্যূনতম উত্তীর্ণ নম্বর কত?
bn.explanation: লিখিত ১২/২৫ + মৌখিক ১২/২৫, সম্মিলিত সর্বনিম্ন ২৫। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।

en.question: Which Article of the Constitution provides the High Court Division's writ jurisdiction?
en.explanation: Article 44 is the right to move the HCD; Article 102 is the writ machinery itself. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: সংবিধানের কোন অনুচ্ছেদ হাইকোর্ট বিভাগের রিট এখতিয়ার প্রদান করে?
bn.explanation: অনুচ্ছেদ ৪৪ হলো HCD-তে যাওয়ার অধিকার; অনুচ্ছেদ ১০২ হলো রিট প্রক্রিয়া নিজেই। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।

en.question: Which sub-clause of Article 102 provides a habeas-corpus-type direction?
en.explanation: 102(2)(b)(ii) is quo warranto; 102(2)(a) covers the mandamus/certiorari-type limb. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: অনুচ্ছেদ ১০২-এর কোন উপ-ধারা হেবিয়াস-কর্পাস-প্রকৃতির নির্দেশ প্রদান করে?
bn.explanation: ১০২(২)(খ)(ii) হলো কো-ওয়ারেন্টো; ১০২(২)(ক) ম্যান্ডামাস/সার্টিওরারি-প্রকৃতির অংশ কভার করে। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।

en.question: Which CrPC section provides the HCD's inherent power, commonly used to quash proceedings?
en.explanation: s.491 is the statutory habeas-corpus route; s.561A is the inherent power. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: কোন CrPC ধারা HCD-এর সহজাত ক্ষমতা প্রদান করে, যা সাধারণত কার্যক্রম বাতিলে ব্যবহৃত হয়?
bn.explanation: ধারা ৪৯১ বিধিবদ্ধ হেবিয়াস কর্পাস পথ; ধারা ৫৬১এ সহজাত ক্ষমতা। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।

en.question: Which CPC section governs the HCD's revisional jurisdiction?
en.explanation: s.96 is ordinary first appeal; s.109 routes appeals to the Appellate Division; s.115 is revision. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: কোন CPC ধারা HCD-এর রিভিশন এখতিয়ার নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে?
bn.explanation: ধারা ৯৬ সাধারণ প্রথম আপিল; ধারা ১০৯ আপিল বিভাগে আপিল পাঠায়; ধারা ১১৫ রিভিশন। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।

en.question: After how many years' subordinate-court practice does the standard route to High Court Permission eligibility open?
en.explanation: Confirmed directly against the Bar Council Order's own text. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: অধস্তন আদালতে কত বছর অনুশীলনের পর হাইকোর্ট পারমিশন যোগ্যতার সাধারণ পথ খোলে?
bn.explanation: বার কাউন্সিল অর্ডারের নিজস্ব পাঠ্য থেকে সরাসরি নিশ্চিত। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।

en.question: Reportedly, after how many years' HCD practice may an advocate apply to the Chief Justice for Appellate Division enrolment?
en.explanation: From reputable secondary sources, not a directly-quoted primary rule — still flagged VERIFY_CURRENT_RULE. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: কথিতভাবে কত বছর HCD অনুশীলনের পর একজন আইনজীবী প্রধান বিচারপতির কাছে আপিল বিভাগ তালিকাভুক্তির আবেদন করতে পারেন?
bn.explanation: নির্ভরযোগ্য গৌণ সূত্র থেকে, সরাসরি উদ্ধৃত মূল বিধি থেকে নয়— এখনো VERIFY_CURRENT_RULE হিসেবে চিহ্নিত। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।

en.question: Under Article 103, which of these is NOT a category where an AD appeal lies as of right?

options.C: A contempt finding by the HCD
options.D: Any case above a set monetary value

en.explanation: There is no general monetary-value as-of-right category — only the 3 confirmed on the Supreme Court's own site. — অনুশীলন (সূত্র: verified HC dataset + Constitution). Not an official past paper.

bn.question: অনুচ্ছেদ ১০৩-এর অধীনে, নিচের কোনটি AD আপিল অধিকারবলে হওয়ার শ্রেণী নয়?

options.D: একটি নির্দিষ্ট আর্থিক মূল্যের ঊর্ধ্বে যেকোনো মামলা

bn.explanation: কোনো সাধারণ আর্থিক-মূল্য অধিকারবলে-শ্রেণী নেই— শুধুমাত্র সুপ্রীম কোর্টের নিজস্ব সাইটে নিশ্চিত ৩টি শ্রেণী রয়েছে। — অনুশীলন। অফিসিয়াল বিগত পেপার নয়।
